name: Stephanas
overview: Stephanas was a male believer in the early Christian church, noted specifically for having a household that the Apostle Paul baptized. There is no information on his tribal affiliation or additional personal details beyond this unique attribute.
namesAndTitles: The name Stephanas appears once in Scripture without an associated meaning or title. It is simply recorded as a proper name in 1 Corinthians 1:16.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Stephanas beyond the fact that he had a household baptized by Paul. No other relationships are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Stephanas is significant in the biblical narrative as an example of an early Christian convert whose household was baptized by Paul, highlighting the spread of the gospel through personal and household faith. His mention in 1 Corinthians underscores his role within the early church community and the importance of household conversions in the New Testament era.
